!28 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Issue 4540. Compare the two DXC panes: they compile the same shader, differing only in the\0A// `static` keyword on the groupshared declaration.\0A//\0A// Look at the global variable declaration just above `define void @main()`, and at the type on\0A// the stores and the load that use it.
